newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy approves members of energy watchdog.
newsitem.headline: Italy approves members of energy watchdog.

text.p: An Italian parliamentary commission on Wednesday approved the members of a regulatory watchdog for the electricity and gas sectors which must be in place before the privatisation of electricity group Enel set for Spring 1997.

The industrial production committee of the Chamber of Deputies (lower house) approved the nomination of Pippo Ranci as the watchdog's chairman. The body requires final approval from the Senate (upper house) before it becomes operational.
The other members of the watchdog are Giuseppe Ammassari and Sergio Garribba. The industry commission of the Senate must now give final approval.

Legislation creating the watchdog for the electricity sector was passed at the end of last year ahead of a hoped-for privatisation of Enel this spring. The flotation was delayed while Italy went through a government crisis.
The centre-left government is also planning to sell a second tranche in energy group ENI in the first half of October following sale of an initial 15 percent stake last year.
